issues.finding: Reply uses Reply-To when present; Reply All includes sender and To/Cc but excludes own addresses. Multiple forwards use the first subject with Fw:. An expanded quote is editable and removable. Compare simplifications that change meaning.

The worker removes the old draft after safely queueing the message, before actual sending succeeds. Undo Send ends at the countdown deadline, even if delivery has not succeeded. Retry is an attempt, not a delivery guarantee.

Memory-only decrypted previews do not imply that separately opened/saved attachments stay off disk. Opened copies persist until later startup cleanup; no origin mark on Linux. A crash during any preview render can disable PDFs. File-type blocking is not a blanket guarantee against arbitrary executable content.

Contact-picture display relies on provider-confirmed From domain, not individual identity. English forged-message-never wording overstates that. Imports skip a card only when it has addresses and every address is already known; matching names is insufficient.

Printing UI differs across platforms; a universal preview-window promise is too specific. Batch saves choose unused names; single Save As follows its platform file dialog. Compare overly broad no-overwrite claims.

issues.finding: Locked means the private part cannot be opened. A locked, refused or unavailable system secret store returns no master key for reading, so reset/missing protection is not the sole cause. Check availability before directing recovery from the private-key backup. Hungarian catalog entry was reopened and corrected in this batch.

STARTTLS is required before authentication: refusal aborts connection, not the app. SMTP 538 reports an encryption requirement and does not establish password correctness. TLS port suggestions require provider support; a local network does not itself provide encryption.

Signature validity proves unchanged signed content, not individual identity. Green/blue signer claims require a valid sender signature; verification applies to all listed addresses. Part counts describe protection states. Decrypted previews stay in memory, separately opened/saved files do not; searchable text can be stored unencrypted locally.

Learning a key does not verify its owner or automatically replace the chosen key. Address lookup first asks the domain and optionally keys.openpgp.org; handle lookup sends an identifier instead. Keep these qualifications where omitted or mistranslated.

issues.finding: Read access includes conversations, message attachments, rules and people lookup. People lookup includes address-book entries and, with every account granted, mail contacts; it is not restricted to saved contacts. Organize uses the same Hungarian Ignore Conversation term as the actual command.

The create/rename log is written after enqueueing a server command, before success is known. Creation can finish its 15-second wait with the folder still absent. Hungarian says the action was requested. Previously completed agent-log-folder was reopened with no duplicate scope credit.

Attachment reads hand content to the agent, not to an external file-opening application. The list count is rows.len(), so grouped conversations can count rows instead of individual messages. A list-name placeable can be a folder or an unlocalized combined-scope identifier. Hungarian uses entries and an uninflected list label.

Unnamed agents are grouped by the recognized terminal program path, not globally across all terminals. --name gives a distinct stored grant, not a verified security identity. Only local programs under the same OS user connect through the supported IPC.

Read summaries combine independent positive counts per program/hour; details can have zero results. Log entries hold subjects, file names, queries and scope labels, not message bodies. Expiry happens on inserts; ordinary nonprotected changes may be pruned before 30 days. Clearing removes read records, hides changes and does not reset sending limits.

Encrypted mail exposes only the outer envelope, not decrypted body or attachments. Saving a draft in the editor, including autosave, ends agent ownership; deletion of other mail requires a destination. Agent-log send undo calls outbox_delete while the queued message remains, unlike the ordinary Undo Send countdown. Server changes are not all visible immediately.

issues.finding: STARTTLS failure ends the connection attempt before authentication. A local network alone is not encryption; provider ports are conditional. Platform certificate trust is the default; explicit CLI certificate pinning exists, but no accept-anything mode or interactive certificate exception control was found.

System secret storage is the default, with an explicit memory-only mode and possible persistence failures. OAuth stores a refresh token even though it does not store the account password. Do not imply browser sign-in has no stored credentials.

Removing an account cascades to outbox rows and removes the stored account credential. Mark All Read applies to messages in every folder. Reordering and properties controls were checked on all three platforms. The preexisting Hungarian paragraph uses one all-inboxes control where English repeats it; retained its markup and used a clear reference back to the same view.

Check validates issuer discovery and endpoint configuration, not client credentials or mail access. Disabling an app affects offering it for new accounts; in-use apps cannot be removed. Google starts disabled for new accounts in this source. Avoid asserting the live verification status of the registered Google client.

TLS failures are broader than certificate identity failures. Raw low-level TLS diagnostics remain English, so the help quotes the actual text and explains it in Hungarian. The secure reader failure uses the current Hungarian catalog sentence.

Raw connection and timeout diagnostics remain English; localized failure wrappers are distinct. Port and TLS mode must match the provider. A queued message survives a failed connection and is retried, but reachability alone does not guarantee successful delivery.

Two-step verification does not universally require or enable app passwords. Gmail app passwords require both two-step verification and account support. Outlook.com/Microsoft 365 guidance uses browser sign-in. iCloud is a supported app-password example. Quotes match current reader failure and sign-in-refused catalogs.

issues.finding: All platforms suppress new-mail notifications when disabled or when the main window is in front, including watched conversations. Core notifications exclude ignored or rule-suppressed mail. Ten-minute sync is supplemented by Inbox watching, not a guarantee of instant arrival. Windows/macOS badge counts refer to Inboxes. Linux dock badges depend on desktop support; closing exits when there is no tray host.

Ahead::Never disables prefetch and neighbor fetches. Recent uses 30 days and 1 MiB for bulk prefetch; neighbor fetches use the size limit but not the date cutoff, and select date-adjacent messages within the folder rather than arbitrary visible rows. Bulk prefetch excludes Junk, Trash and All. Cache eviction removes bodies, not whole messages or the entire database, and spares Drafts and messages opened in this run. The byte cap can therefore be exceeded. Large-message text-first rendering above 1 MiB is conditional on a usable structure and sufficiently small initial parts.

Quoted headings now match the actual Hungarian catalog. Missing local content is fetched on opening; arrival time is not guaranteed. An open failed message is retried after account sync; explicit retry remains platform-specific. A parser failure establishes that Inbox Classic could not read the message, not that no other mail program can. WebView2 Runtime may need installation and is distinct from the installed Edge browser.

The card is a local analysis of a recognized delivery report. Its links to original mail depend on finding that message in the account. A delayed report does not establish final failure or guarantee later delivery. Resend guidance is limited to final failures; avoid a guaranteed greylisting delivery time. Local analysis does not imply the entire app or rendered message performs no network access.

Rules process new Inbox arrivals, or existing mail after Apply Now. Message-based rules prefer the list ID and otherwise the sender. Matching scope respects the chosen account. Plans stop further rule matching once a valid away action is chosen, before server confirmation. Delete only plans a move when Trash exists; it never falls back to permanent deletion. Folder/date query operators are rejected. Retain the existing literal operator examples and platform-independent wording for background operation.

Direct requests require user confirmation and a trusted provider DKIM verdict for a signature covering both unsubscribe headers. They make an HTTP request rather than sending email. Mailto opens a draft for the user to send; browser mode is completed outside the app. Only direct HTTP mode has an app-observed acceptance result. A 2xx response maps to UiUnsubscribed without verifying future mail cessation, so that previously reviewed Hungarian value was reopened and shortened to request acceptance. No additional scope credit.

issues.finding: Paths describe defaults: --store and Linux data-directory settings can override them. The mail database itself is not encrypted. Account passwords, OAuth refresh tokens and application client secrets use the system secret store by default; unavailable or memory-only storage must not be described as guaranteed persistence. Linux uses a Secret Service provider, not exclusively GNOME Keyring. Private OpenPGP keys are encrypted in the database with a separate protection key. Local analysis does not mean the entire application makes no network requests.

DNS over HTTPS applies to configuration MX/SRV lookups; ordinary server hostname resolution uses the system resolver. Provider autoconfig requests can include an email address. Autodiscover sends a password only after a HTTPS Basic challenge. Logos use persistent cached SVG data, not a fresh download on every app run: source retention is 30 days, failed requests wait 24 hours. External pictures can be enabled by settings/trusted-sender rules; encrypted parts still require a click. Direct unsubscribe requires confirmation and trusted DKIM coverage of the unsubscribe headers. Key discovery includes manual lookup and fingerprint/key-ID requests; publishing sends public key data and confirmation addresses. OTP detection uses a trusted provider verdict for the relevant origin/From domain or a parent, not any DKIM signature. Mac automatic update checking is optional.

The passphrase must match and contain at least eight Unicode characters. Only protected exports can contain saved account/app secrets and own private keys. Private keys that cannot be opened locally are skipped. Setup exports contain no messages, so only server-held mail can download on the other machine; local outgoing mail is not transferred. An unprotected export requires fresh sign-in, potentially through the browser. Existing accounts are kept, selected contained settings applied, contacts merged, pending rule folders resolved after sync and replacement contact keys left for user selection.

The Windows uninstaller's remove-mail confirmation deletes the full local data directory, including settings, contacts, keys and queued mail; WebView cache is removed separately. Mac/Linux data-folder removal also affects these local records. This does not delete server mail. Removing an account requests removal of its account credential, not every application/PGP secret. The Windows uninstaller explicitly leaves system credential-store entries, and uninstalling must not be represented as clearing all secrets. Preserve literal package commands without executing them.

Mac Sparkle checks are enabled by default but controlled by settings; the help must not promise unconditional automatic updating or a prompt before every possible installation. Describe following updater instructions. Linux repository/package instructions are conditional on installation method, without an unconditional claim about a particular distribution's update service. Installer paths preserve the existing local data.

Windows opens system association settings for installed copies when the association is not already set. Mac/Linux attempt system association changes and report failure; success is not unconditional. Mailto and .eml associations are separate. Mailto parsing accepts addresses, subject and body, not attachments or arbitrary fields. All three frontends require an existing account and ask the user to click the link again after adding one.

issues.finding: Trusted provider BIMI/DMARC results concern a sender domain, not personal identity. Logos use a persistent cache and can require an initial or later refresh request, so neither a per-run download claim nor a claim that the server learns nothing is justified. List rows may show a verified contact's picture instead of initials. The SVG renderer does not run embedded scripts or load external image resources.

The sign-in-page-file flag writes the OAuth page URL, not HTML/page contents, in all three frontends. Memory-passwords selects memory credential storage; --store selects a mail database. A PEM pin file can contain several accepted certificates, a DER file one. Background startup omits the main window, and --mcp is launched by the agent program. A mailto argument requires an already configured account to open a compose window. Literal options, placeholders and executable paths are preserved.

The reader summarizes the first recognized calendar event. UTC or a zone defined by the calendar can be converted to local time; an unrecognized/missing zone uses the given clock time without conversion, while formatting remains localized. Details are conditional on available fields. The current master opens an event file in an external calendar application; responses depend on that application. An open failure need not prove no calendar application is installed. Incoming phase3b changes to this topic remain queued separately.

The first section is generated per menu rather than being a single table. Preserve its generator and every literal key. Cc/Bcc access keys come from the actual localized labels: Hungarian Windows &Másolat / &Titkos másolat and GTK _Másolat / _Titkos másolat give Alt+M / Alt+T, explained beside the preserved English Alt+C / Alt+B literals. Shift-arrow can expand or shrink a selection; Return opens drafts for editing. Tab follows focusable controls, not exclusively three panes. Select All in the editor unfolds quoted content. Completion accepts addresses and groups, and Shift+Delete permanently hides remembered addresses without deleting saved address-book entries/groups. Address-book Delete can also remove a manually entered group address.

Windows Cancel discards unapplied values/trusted-sender removals, but does not undo a system association selected outside the dialog. Mac/Linux settings apply immediately except language, which needs restart. Preferred-language resolution can try several choices before English fallback. Send delay applies before sending, notifications suppress foreground announcements and code notifications have prerequisites. Preview toggles distinguish images from PDFs. Encrypted-part external images still require a click; trusted sender rules require domain validation. Decrypted indexing requires accessible keys and stores local plaintext, excluded from agent search. Key lookup can send a fingerprint/key ID. Download limits concern cached bodies with exemptions, not a hard database cap. Apple's Hungarian guide confirms the Language & Region path; the help avoids a version-dependent final Applications/Apps label.

The actual Hungarian heading is domain followed by kódja, not the draft's quoted Kód innen. Trusted provider DKIM results must cover the relevant domain or its parent; this does not certify personal identity or all message claims. Junk/Sent/Drafts suppress cards. The more-than-one-hour warning uses the message Date timestamp at rendering, not a check with the code issuer. Notification extraction also requires enabled notifications, fresh/small mail and a timely source download. Existing code/notification catalog values were retained; no catalog scope credit is added.

verified_context: The send confirmation receives only SEND_DELAY=30. Its log is written after queueing, before delivery. Undo::Unsend checks only for the Outbox row, not delivery; manual removal can also make Undo unavailable.

Permission summaries use infinitives and capitalize the first list item. Account counts are independent; Slovak one is 1, few is 2-4 and other is 0/5+, with integer callers. The new-recipient warning handles counts greater than one.
READ covers message listing, searches, rule inspection/query previews without actions and contact-prefix lookup. Encrypted bodies and attachments remain unavailable to agents.

Unsubscribe confirmation covers a batch, defaults to refusal and counts approved lists per program over the preceding 86400 seconds, including failed HTTP requests. Existing messages remain unchanged and no email is sent.

Only the program-owned, unmodified draft in Drafts can be changed or permanently discarded. User save/autosave or sending immediately takes it over and guards queued agent writes. Opening alone does not; independent read permissions are not revoked.
Signature text is included by default but optional. One send confirmation per program can be waiting. Send controls briefly delay activation and refusal is the default.

Connection configuration is mcpServers JSON. The relay starts the app with --background and the local channel is restricted to the current OS user. The global switch is checked on each call. GTK SwitchRow and Mac/Windows checkboxes share the setting.
The Windows unsubscribe buttons use separate O/N mnemonics and measured widths; shared Mac/Linux labels contain no ampersand. The existing Slovak shutdown instruction is preserved.
source_issues: English send/Undo wording overstates delivery; the blanket no-permanent-deletion help claim excludes the actual own-draft discard operation.
The quota is rolling per program; footer text is optional; email content must not be followed as instructions.

verified_context: The send confirmation receives only SEND_DELAY=30. Its log is written after queueing, before delivery. Undo::Unsend checks only for the Outbox row, not delivery; manual removal can also make Undo unavailable.

Permission summaries use nouns and capitalize the first list item. Account counts are independent; Slovenian one includes 1/101, two includes 2/102, few includes 3/4/103/104. Existing numeric placeholders and exact-one unsubscribe branch are retained. The new-recipient warning handles counts greater than one and introduces the numeric count after a colon.
READ covers message listing, searches, rule inspection/query previews without actions and contact-prefix lookup. Encrypted bodies and attachments remain unavailable to agents.

Unsubscribe confirmation covers a batch, defaults to refusal and counts approved lists per program over the preceding 86400 seconds, including failed HTTP requests. Existing messages remain unchanged and no email is sent.

Only the program-owned, unmodified draft in Drafts can be changed or permanently discarded. User save/autosave or sending immediately takes it over and guards queued agent writes. Opening alone does not; independent read permissions are not revoked.
Signature text is included by default but optional. One send confirmation per program can be waiting. Send controls briefly delay activation and refusal is the default.

Connection configuration is mcpServers JSON. The relay starts the app with --background and the local channel is restricted to the current OS user. The global switch is checked on each call. GTK SwitchRow and Mac/Windows checkboxes share the setting.

The Windows unsubscribe buttons use separate O/N mnemonics and measured widths; shared Mac/Linux labels contain no ampersand. The affirmative action now uses imperative Odjavi, paired with Ne odjavi. Its additional reader link and dialog-title callers on all three platforms were inspected. The reviewed shutdown instruction is preserved.
source_issues: English send/Undo wording overstates delivery; the blanket no-permanent-deletion help claim excludes the actual own-draft discard operation.
The quota is rolling per program; footer text is optional; email content must not be followed as instructions.

core/crates/pe-html/help/bg/connections..inserted_passage: • Ключовете за шифроване, само когато шифровате за някого, чийто ключ нямате: собственият домейн на адреса му (Web Key Directory), след това keys.openpgp.org, освен ако не сте го изключили. Изпраща се само адресът.

core/crates/pe-html/help/bg/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Ключовете за шифроване се пазят заедно с изтеглената поща. Частните ви ключове са шифровани там с ключ, който се пази до паролите ви, така че файлът с пощата сам по себе си не може да ги отвори.

core/crates/pe-html/help/bg/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Ключовете пътуват и с пощата. Съобщенията от адрес с ключ носят публичния му ключ, за да могат други приложения да шифроват за вас, а Inbox Classic по същия начин научава ключа на контакт от неговите съобщения. За да спрете изпращането на своя, изключете в раздела на акаунта.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ca/connections..inserted_passage: • Les claus de xifratge, només quan xifreu per a algú de qui no teniu la clau: el domini de la seva adreça (Web Key Directory) i després keys.openpgp.org, tret que l’hàgiu desactivat. Només s’envia l’adreça.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ca/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Les claus de xifratge es desen amb el correu baixat. Les vostres claus privades hi són xifrades amb una clau desada al costat de les contrasenyes, de manera que el fitxer del correu sol no les pot obrir.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ca/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Les claus també viatgen amb el correu. Els missatges d’una adreça amb clau porten la seva clau pública, perquè altres aplicacions us puguin xifrar missatges, i Inbox Classic aprèn la clau d’un contacte dels seus missatges de la mateixa manera. Per deixar d’enviar la vostra, desactiveu a la pestanya del compte.

core/crates/pe-html/help/cs/connections..inserted_passage: • Šifrovací klíče, jen když šifrujete někomu, jehož klíč nemáte: vlastní doména jeho adresy (Web Key Directory), potom keys.openpgp.org, pokud jste to nevypnuli. Odesílá se jen adresa.

core/crates/pe-html/help/cs/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Šifrovací klíče jsou uloženy se staženou poštou. Vaše soukromé klíče jsou tam zašifrované klíčem uloženým vedle vašich hesel, takže samotný soubor s poštou je otevřít nemůže.

core/crates/pe-html/help/cs/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Klíče putují i s poštou. Zprávy z adresy s klíčem nesou její veřejný klíč, aby vám jiné aplikace mohly šifrovat, a Inbox Classic se stejně naučí klíč kontaktu z jeho zpráv. Chcete-li svůj klíč přestat posílat, vypněte na kartě účtu.

core/crates/pe-html/help/da/connections..inserted_passage: • Krypteringsnøgler, kun når du krypterer til en, hvis nøgle du ikke har: adressens eget domæne (Web Key Directory) og derefter keys.openpgp.org, medmindre du har slået det fra. Kun adressen sendes.

core/crates/pe-html/help/da/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Krypteringsnøgler gemmes sammen med den hentede mail. Dine private nøgler er krypteret dér med en nøgle, der ligger ved siden af dine adgangskoder, så mailfilen alene ikke kan åbne dem.

core/crates/pe-html/help/da/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Nøgler følger også med mailen. Beskeder fra en adresse med en nøgle har dens offentlige nøgle med, så andre apps kan kryptere til dig, og Inbox Classic lærer en kontakts nøgle fra deres beskeder på samme måde. Hvis du ikke vil sende din med, skal du slå fra under fanen for kontoen.

core/crates/pe-html/help/de/connections..inserted_passage: • Verschlüsselungsschlüssel, nur wenn Sie an jemanden verschlüsseln, dessen Schlüssel Sie nicht haben: die eigene Domain der Adresse (Web Key Directory), dann keys.openpgp.org, sofern Sie das nicht deaktiviert haben. Nur die Adresse wird gesendet.

core/crates/pe-html/help/de/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Verschlüsselungsschlüssel liegen bei den heruntergeladenen E-Mails. Ihre privaten Schlüssel sind dort mit einem Schlüssel verschlüsselt, der neben Ihren Passwörtern liegt, sodass die E-Mail-Datei allein sie nicht öffnen kann.

core/crates/pe-html/help/de/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Schlüssel reisen auch mit der E-Mail. Nachrichten von einer Adresse mit Schlüssel enthalten deren öffentlichen Schlüssel, damit andere Programme an Sie verschlüsseln können, und Inbox Classic lernt den Schlüssel eines Kontakts auf dieselbe Weise aus dessen Nachrichten. Damit Ihr Schlüssel nicht mehr mitgesendet wird, deaktivieren Sie auf der Registerkarte des Kontos.

core/crates/pe-html/help/el/connections..inserted_passage: • Κλειδιά κρυπτογράφησης, μόνο όταν κρυπτογραφείτε για κάποιον του οποίου το κλειδί δεν έχετε: πρώτα ο τομέας της διεύθυνσής του (Web Key Directory), μετά το keys.openpgp.org, εκτός αν το έχετε απενεργοποιήσει. Αποστέλλεται μόνο η διεύθυνση.

core/crates/pe-html/help/el/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Τα κλειδιά κρυπτογράφησης φυλάσσονται μαζί με την αλληλογραφία που έχει ληφθεί. Τα ιδιωτικά σας κλειδιά είναι εκεί κρυπτογραφημένα με ένα κλειδί που φυλάσσεται δίπλα στους κωδικούς πρόσβασής σας, οπότε το αρχείο της αλληλογραφίας μόνο του δεν μπορεί να τα ανοίξει.

core/crates/pe-html/help/el/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Τα κλειδιά ταξιδεύουν και με την αλληλογραφία. Τα μηνύματα από μια διεύθυνση με κλειδί φέρουν το δημόσιο κλειδί της, ώστε άλλες εφαρμογές να μπορούν να κρυπτογραφούν για εσάς, και το Inbox Classic μαθαίνει με τον ίδιο τρόπο το κλειδί μιας επαφής από τα μηνύματά της. Για να σταματήσετε να στέλνετε το δικό σας, απενεργοποιήστε το στην καρτέλα του λογαριασμού.

core/crates/pe-html/help/en/connections..inserted_passage: • Encryption keys, only when you encrypt to someone whose key you do not have: their address’s own domain (Web Key Directory), then keys.openpgp.org unless you turned it off. Only the address is sent.

core/crates/pe-html/help/en/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Encryption keys are kept with your downloaded mail. Your private keys are encrypted there with a key kept beside your passwords, so the mail file alone cannot open them.

core/crates/pe-html/help/en/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Keys also travel with mail. Messages from an address with a key carry its public key, so other apps can encrypt to you, and Inbox Classic learns a contact’s key from their messages the same way. To stop sending yours, turn off on the account’s tab.

core/crates/pe-html/help/es/connections..inserted_passage: • Las claves de cifrado, solo cuando usted cifra para alguien cuya clave no tiene: el dominio propio de su dirección (Web Key Directory) y después keys.openpgp.org, salvo que lo haya desactivado. Solo se envía la dirección.

core/crates/pe-html/help/es/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Las claves de cifrado se guardan con el correo descargado. Sus claves privadas están cifradas allí con una clave guardada junto a sus contraseñas, así que el archivo del correo por sí solo no puede abrirlas.

core/crates/pe-html/help/es/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Las claves también viajan con el correo. Los mensajes de una dirección con clave llevan su clave pública, para que otras aplicaciones puedan cifrarle mensajes, e Inbox Classic aprende la clave de un contacto de sus mensajes de la misma manera. Para dejar de enviar la suya, desactive en la pestaña de la cuenta.

core/crates/pe-html/help/et/connections..inserted_passage: • Krüpteerimisvõtmed, ainult siis, kui krüpteerite kellelegi, kelle võtit teil pole: tema aadressi enda domeen (Web Key Directory), seejärel keys.openpgp.org, kui te pole seda välja lülitanud. Saadetakse ainult aadress.

core/crates/pe-html/help/et/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Krüpteerimisvõtmeid hoitakse koos alla laaditud postiga. Teie privaatvõtmed on seal krüpteeritud võtmega, mida hoitakse teie paroolide kõrval, nii et postifail üksi ei saa neid avada.

core/crates/pe-html/help/et/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Võtmed liiguvad ka koos postiga. Võtmega aadressilt saadetud kirjad kannavad selle avalikku võtit, et teised rakendused saaksid sulle krüpteerida, ja Inbox Classic õpib samamoodi kontakti võtme tema kirjadest. Kui sa ei soovi oma võtit enam saata, lülita välja konto vahekaardil .

core/crates/pe-html/help/fi/connections..inserted_passage: • Salausavaimet: vain kun salaat viestin jollekulle, jonka avainta sinulla ei ole. Ensin osoitteen oma verkkotunnus (Web Key Directory), sitten keys.openpgp.org, ellet ole poistanut sitä käytöstä. Vain osoite lähetetään.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fi/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Salausavaimet säilytetään ladatun postin kanssa. Yksityiset avaimesi on salattu siellä avaimella, jota säilytetään salasanojesi rinnalla, joten pelkkä postitiedosto ei voi avata niitä.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fi/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Avaimet kulkevat myös postin mukana. Avaimellisesta osoitteesta lähetetyissä viesteissä on mukana sen julkinen avain, jotta muut sovellukset voivat salata viestejä sinulle, ja Inbox Classic oppii samalla tavalla yhteystiedon avaimen tämän viesteistä. Jos et halua enää lähettää omaasi, poista käytöstä tilin välilehdellä .

core/crates/pe-html/help/fr/connections..inserted_passage: • Les clés de chiffrement, seulement quand vous chiffrez pour quelqu’un dont vous n’avez pas la clé : le domaine de son adresse (Web Key Directory), puis keys.openpgp.org, sauf si vous l’avez désactivé. Seule l’adresse est envoyée.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fr/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Les clés de chiffrement sont conservées avec le courrier téléchargé. Vos clés privées y sont chiffrées avec une clé conservée à côté de vos mots de passe, si bien que le fichier du courrier seul ne peut pas les ouvrir.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fr/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Les clés voyagent aussi avec le courrier. Les messages d’une adresse qui a une clé portent sa clé publique, pour que d’autres applications puissent vous chiffrer des messages, et Inbox Classic apprend de la même façon la clé d’un contact par ses messages. Pour ne plus envoyer la vôtre, désactivez sous l’onglet du compte.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hr/connections..inserted_passage: • Ključevi za šifriranje, samo kad šifrirate nekome čiji ključ nemate: vlastita domena njegove adrese (Web Key Directory), zatim keys.openpgp.org, osim ako ste to isključili. Šalje se samo adresa.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hr/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Ključevi za šifriranje čuvaju se uz preuzetu poštu. Vaši privatni ključevi ondje su šifrirani ključem koji se čuva uz vaše lozinke, pa ih sama datoteka s poštom ne može otvoriti.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hr/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Ključevi putuju i s poštom. Poruke s adrese koja ima ključ nose njezin javni ključ kako bi vam druge aplikacije mogle šifrirati poruke, a Inbox Classic na isti način uči ključ kontakta iz njegovih poruka. Da biste prestali slati svoj, isključite na kartici računa.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hu/connections..inserted_passage: • Titkosítási kulcsok, csak ha olyasvalakinek titkosít, akinek nincs meg a kulcsa: először a címe saját tartománya (Web Key Directory), majd a keys.openpgp.org, hacsak ki nem kapcsolta. Csak a cím kerül elküldésre.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hu/data-storage.inserted_passage: • A titkosítási kulcsokat a letöltött levelekkel együtt tárolja. A privát kulcsai ott titkosítva vannak egy kulccsal, amely a jelszavai mellett van tárolva, így a levelek fájlja önmagában nem nyithatja meg őket.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hu/encryption-k.inserted_passage: A kulcsok a levelekkel is utaznak. Egy kulccsal rendelkező címről küldött üzenetek magukkal viszik a nyilvános kulcsát, így más alkalmazások titkosíthatnak Önnek, és az Inbox Classic ugyanígy megtanulja egy partner kulcsát az üzeneteiből. Ha nem szeretné tovább küldeni a sajátját, kapcsolja ki ezt a fiók lapján: .

core/crates/pe-html/help/it/connections..inserted_passage: • Chiavi di crittografia, solo quando cifri per qualcuno di cui non hai la chiave: il dominio del suo indirizzo (Web Key Directory), poi keys.openpgp.org, a meno che tu non l’abbia disattivato. Viene inviato solo l’indirizzo.

core/crates/pe-html/help/it/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Le chiavi di crittografia sono conservate con la posta scaricata. Le tue chiavi private vi sono cifrate con una chiave conservata accanto alle password, quindi il file della posta da solo non può aprirle.

core/crates/pe-html/help/it/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Le chiavi viaggiano anche con la posta. I messaggi da un indirizzo con una chiave portano la sua chiave pubblica, così altre app possono cifrare per te, e Inbox Classic impara allo stesso modo la chiave di un contatto dai suoi messaggi. Per smettere di inviare la tua, disattiva nella scheda dell’account.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lt/connections..inserted_passage: • Šifravimo raktai, tik kai šifruojate kam nors, kurio rakto neturite: pirmiausia jo adreso domenas (Web Key Directory), tada keys.openpgp.org, nebent tai išjungėte. Siunčiamas tik adresas.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lt/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Šifravimo raktai laikomi kartu su atsisiųstais laiškais. Jūsų privatieji raktai ten užšifruoti raktu, laikomu šalia jūsų slaptažodžių, todėl vien pašto failas jų atverti negali.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lt/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Raktai keliauja ir su paštu. Laiškai iš adreso, turinčio raktą, neša jo viešąjį raktą, kad kitos programos galėtų jums šifruoti, o Inbox Classic tokiu pat būdu sužino kontakto raktą iš jo laiškų. Jei nebenorite siųsti savojo, išjunkite paskyros skirtuke .

core/crates/pe-html/help/lv/connections..inserted_passage: • Šifrēšanas atslēgas, tikai tad, ja šifrējat kādam, kura atslēgas jums nav: vispirms viņa adreses domēns (Web Key Directory), tad keys.openpgp.org, ja vien neesat to izslēdzis. Tiek nosūtīta tikai adrese.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lv/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Šifrēšanas atslēgas tiek glabātas kopā ar lejupielādēto pastu. Jūsu privātās atslēgas tur ir šifrētas ar atslēgu, kas glabājas blakus jūsu parolēm, tāpēc pasta fails viens pats tās atvērt nevar.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lv/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Atslēgas ceļo arī kopā ar pastu. Ziņojumi no adreses ar atslēgu nes tās publisko atslēgu, lai citas lietotnes varētu jums šifrēt, un Inbox Classic tāpat uzzina kontaktpersonas atslēgu no tās ziņojumiem. Lai pārtrauktu sūtīt savējo, izslēdziet konta cilnē .

core/crates/pe-html/help/nb/connections..inserted_passage: • Krypteringsnøkler, bare når du krypterer til noen du ikke har nøkkelen til: domenet til adressen (Web Key Directory), deretter keys.openpgp.org hvis du ikke har slått det av. Bare adressen sendes.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nb/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Krypteringsnøkler lagres sammen med den nedlastede e-posten. De private nøklene dine er kryptert der med en nøkkel som ligger ved siden av passordene dine, så e-postfilen alene kan ikke åpne dem.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nb/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Nøkler følger også med e-posten. Meldinger fra en adresse med nøkkel har med den offentlige nøkkelen, slik at andre apper kan kryptere til deg, og Inbox Classic lærer en kontakts nøkkel fra meldingene deres på samme måte. Hvis du ikke vil sende din lenger, slår du av i fanen for kontoen.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nl/connections..inserted_passage: • Sleutels voor versleuteling, alleen als je versleutelt naar iemand van wie je de sleutel niet hebt: eerst het eigen domein van het adres (Web Key Directory), dan keys.openpgp.org, tenzij je dat hebt uitgezet. Alleen het adres wordt verstuurd.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nl/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Sleutels voor versleuteling worden bij de gedownloade mail bewaard. Je privésleutels zijn daar versleuteld met een sleutel die naast je wachtwoorden wordt bewaard, zodat het mailbestand alleen ze niet kan openen.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nl/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Sleutels reizen ook mee met de mail. Berichten van een adres met een sleutel dragen de openbare sleutel mee, zodat andere apps naar je kunnen versleutelen, en Inbox Classic leert op dezelfde manier de sleutel van een contact uit diens berichten. Wil je de jouwe niet meer meesturen, zet dan uit op het tabblad van het account.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pl/connections..inserted_passage: • Klucze szyfrowania, tylko gdy szyfrujesz do kogoś, czyjego klucza nie masz: najpierw domena jego adresu (Web Key Directory), potem keys.openpgp.org, chyba że to wyłączysz. Wysyłany jest tylko adres.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pl/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Klucze szyfrowania są przechowywane razem z pobraną pocztą. Twoje klucze prywatne są tam zaszyfrowane kluczem przechowywanym obok haseł, więc sam plik poczty nie może ich otworzyć.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pl/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Klucze podróżują też z pocztą. Wiadomości z adresu, który ma klucz, niosą jego klucz publiczny, aby inne aplikacje mogły szyfrować do ciebie, a Inbox Classic w ten sam sposób poznaje klucz kontaktu z jego wiadomości. Aby przestać wysyłać swój, wyłącz na karcie konta.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt-BR/connectio.inserted_passage: • Chaves de criptografia, só quando você criptografa para alguém cuja chave você não tem: o domínio do endereço da pessoa (Web Key Directory) e depois keys.openpgp.org, a menos que você tenha desativado. Só o endereço é enviado.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt-BR/data-stor.inserted_passage: • As chaves de criptografia ficam junto com os e-mails baixados. Suas chaves privadas estão criptografadas lá com uma chave guardada junto das suas senhas, então o arquivo de e-mails sozinho não consegue abri-las.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt-BR/encryptio.inserted_passage: As chaves também viajam com os e-mails. As mensagens de um endereço com chave levam a chave pública dele, para que outros aplicativos possam criptografar para você, e o Inbox Classic aprende da mesma forma a chave de um contato pelas mensagens dele. Para parar de enviar a sua, desative na guia da conta.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt/connections..inserted_passage: • Chaves de encriptação, só quando encripta para alguém cuja chave não tem: o domínio do endereço dessa pessoa (Web Key Directory) e depois keys.openpgp.org, a menos que o tenha desativado. Só o endereço é enviado.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt/data-storage.inserted_passage: • As chaves de encriptação são guardadas com o correio transferido. As suas chaves privadas estão encriptadas aí com uma chave guardada junto das palavras-passe, pelo que o ficheiro do correio sozinho não as consegue abrir.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt/encryption-k.inserted_passage: As chaves também viajam com o correio. As mensagens de um endereço com chave levam a sua chave pública, para que outras aplicações possam encriptar para si, e o Inbox Classic aprende da mesma forma a chave de um contacto a partir das mensagens dele. Para deixar de enviar a sua, desative no separador da conta.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ro/connections..inserted_passage: • Cheile de criptare, doar când criptați pentru cineva a cărui cheie nu o aveți: întâi domeniul adresei sale (Web Key Directory), apoi keys.openpgp.org, dacă nu l-ați dezactivat. Se trimite doar adresa.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ro/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Cheile de criptare sunt păstrate împreună cu e-mailurile descărcate. Cheile dvs. private sunt criptate acolo cu o cheie păstrată lângă parolele dvs., astfel încât fișierul cu e-mailuri singur nu le poate deschide.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ro/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Cheile călătoresc și odată cu e-mailurile. Mesajele de la o adresă cu cheie poartă cheia ei publică, astfel încât alte aplicații să poată cripta pentru dvs., iar Inbox Classic află la fel cheia unui contact din mesajele lui. Pentru a nu mai trimite cheia dvs., dezactivați în fila a contului.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ru/connections..inserted_passage: • Ключи шифрования: только когда вы шифруете для того, чьего ключа у вас нет. Сначала собственный домен его адреса (Web Key Directory), затем keys.openpgp.org, если вы это не отключили. Отправляется только адрес.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ru/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Ключи шифрования хранятся вместе с загруженной почтой. Ваши закрытые ключи зашифрованы там ключом, который хранится рядом с вашими паролями, поэтому один лишь файл почты не может их открыть.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ru/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Ключи путешествуют и вместе с почтой. Сообщения с адреса, у которого есть ключ, несут его открытый ключ, чтобы другие приложения могли шифровать для вас, и Inbox Classic так же узнает ключ контакта из его сообщений. Чтобы больше не отправлять свой ключ, отключите на вкладке учетной записи.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sk/connections..inserted_passage: • Šifrovacie kľúče, iba keď šifrujete niekomu, koho kľúč nemáte: vlastná doména jeho adresy (Web Key Directory), potom keys.openpgp.org, ak ste to nevypli. Odosiela sa iba adresa.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sk/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Šifrovacie kľúče sa uchovávajú so stiahnutou poštou. Vaše súkromné kľúče sú tam zašifrované kľúčom uloženým vedľa vašich hesiel, takže samotný súbor s poštou ich otvoriť nemôže.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sk/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Kľúče cestujú aj s poštou. Správy z adresy s kľúčom nesú jej verejný kľúč, aby vám iné aplikácie mohli šifrovať, a Inbox Classic sa rovnako naučí kľúč kontaktu z jeho správ. Ak chcete prestať posielať svoj, vypnite na karte konta.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sl/connections..inserted_passage: • Šifrirni ključi, samo kadar šifrirate nekomu, čigar ključa nimate: najprej lastna domena njegovega naslova (Web Key Directory), nato keys.openpgp.org, razen če ste to izklopili. Pošlje se samo naslov.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sl/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Šifrirni ključi so shranjeni skupaj s preneseno pošto. Vaši zasebni ključi so tam šifrirani s ključem, shranjenim poleg vaših gesel, zato jih datoteka s pošto sama ne more odpreti.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sl/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Ključi potujejo tudi s pošto. Sporočila z naslova s ključem nosijo njegov javni ključ, da vam lahko druge aplikacije šifrirajo, Inbox Classic pa se na enak način nauči ključ stika iz njegovih sporočil. Če želite nehati pošiljati svojega, izklopite na zavihku računa.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/connect.inserted_passage: • Ključevi za šifrovanje, samo kada šifrujete nekome čiji ključ nemate: prvo domen njegove adrese (Web Key Directory), zatim keys.openpgp.org, osim ako ste to isključili. Šalje se samo adresa.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/data-st.inserted_passage: • Ključevi za šifrovanje čuvaju se uz preuzetu poštu. Vaši privatni ključevi su tamo šifrovani ključem koji se čuva pored vaših lozinki, pa sama datoteka sa poštom ne može da ih otvori.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/encrypt.inserted_passage: Ključevi putuju i sa poštom. Poruke sa adrese koja ima ključ nose njen javni ključ kako bi druge aplikacije mogle da vam šifruju poruke, a Inbox Classic na isti način saznaje ključ kontakta iz njegovih poruka. Da biste prestali da šaljete svoj, isključite na kartici naloga.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sv/connections..inserted_passage: • Krypteringsnycklar, bara när du krypterar till någon vars nyckel du inte har: först adressens egen domän (Web Key Directory), sedan keys.openpgp.org om du inte har stängt av det. Bara adressen skickas.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sv/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Krypteringsnycklar sparas tillsammans med den hämtade e-posten. Dina privata nycklar är krypterade där med en nyckel som sparas bredvid dina lösenord, så e-postfilen ensam kan inte öppna dem.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sv/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Nycklar följer också med e-posten. Meddelanden från en adress med en nyckel bär med sig dess offentliga nyckel, så att andra appar kan kryptera till dig, och Inbox Classic lär sig en kontakts nyckel från deras meddelanden på samma sätt. Om du inte längre vill skicka din stänger du av på fliken för kontot.

core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/connections..inserted_passage: • Şifreleme anahtarları: yalnızca anahtarına sahip olmadığınız birine şifrelediğinizde. Önce adresin kendi alan adı (Web Key Directory), sonra kapatmadıysanız keys.openpgp.org. Yalnızca adres gönderilir.

core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Şifreleme anahtarları indirilen postayla birlikte saklanır. Özel anahtarlarınız orada, parolalarınızın yanında saklanan bir anahtarla şifrelenmiştir; bu yüzden posta dosyası tek başına onları açamaz.

core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Anahtarlar postayla birlikte de gider. Anahtarı olan bir adresten gelen iletiler o adresin ortak anahtarını taşır; böylece başka uygulamalar size şifreleyebilir, Inbox Classic de bir kişinin anahtarını aynı şekilde onun iletilerinden öğrenir. Kendi anahtarınızı göndermeyi bırakmak için hesabın sekmesinde seçeneğini kapatın.

core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/connections..inserted_passage: • Ключі шифрування, лише коли ви шифруєте для того, чийого ключа у вас немає: спершу власний домен його адреси (Web Key Directory), потім keys.openpgp.org, якщо ви цього не вимкнули. Надсилається лише адреса.

core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/data-storage.inserted_passage: • Ключі шифрування зберігаються разом із завантаженою поштою. Ваші закриті ключі зашифровані там ключем, що зберігається поруч із вашими паролями, тож сам файл пошти не може їх відкрити.

core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/encryption-k.inserted_passage: Ключі мандрують і разом із поштою. Повідомлення з адреси, що має ключ, несуть її відкритий ключ, щоб інші застосунки могли шифрувати для вас, а Inbox Classic так само дізнається ключ контакту з його повідомлень. Щоб більше не надсилати свій ключ, вимкніть на вкладці облікового запису.

Първия път, когато агентът на дадена програма се свърже, Inbox Classic ви пита, като назовава програмата. Изберете какво може да прави:

    -

    • +

  • подреждане на поща: прочетено, флагове, нежелана поща, преместване, архивиране, нови папки и изтриване в , както и отписване от пощенски списъци след вашето „да“

  • писане на чернови, които вие изпращате
    • +
  • писане на чернови, които вие изпращате, и промяна или премахване на написаните от него чернови, докато не ги промените вие
  • изпращане на поща, всяко съобщение само след вашето „да“

След това изберете акаунтите, които може да вижда, и щракнете върху . отказва достъп на програмата и няма да бъдете питани за нея отново.

Agent vpraša za eno sporočilo naenkrat. Če z odgovorom odlašate, agent izve, da sporočilo čaka na vas, in lahko pozneje vpraša, kako ste se odločili. Sporočila in osnutki, ki jih napiše, se končajo z vašim podpisom, tako kot vaši.

Sporočilo, ki ga pošljete, 30 sekund čaka v mapi Odpošiljanje. Dokler ne odide, ga lahko tam izbrišete ali kliknete v meniju > .

+

Osnutki, ki jih napiše agent

+

Ko odprete osnutek, ki ga je napisal agent, je ime agenta navedeno v vrstici nad sporočilom. Pred pošiljanjem preverite prejemnike in besedilo.

+

Agent lahko svoj osnutek spremeni ali odstrani, dokler ga sami ne shranite. Od takrat je osnutek vaš.

Agent, ki ima tudi druga orodja, na primer brskanje po spletu ali branje vaših datotek, bi lahko prek njih posredoval, kar prebere. Inbox Classic jih ne vidi. Agentu dovolite pošiljanje samo, če ga res potrebujete.

Izaberite šta svaki AI agent sme da radi sa vašom poštom i pogledajte i opozovite ono što je uradio.

Kada se agent nekog programa prvi put poveže, Inbox Classic vas pita i navodi naziv programa. Izaberite šta sme da radi:

    -
  • da čita poštu: fascikle, listu poruka, pretragu i poruke
    • +
  • da čita poštu: fascikle, listu poruka, razgovore, pretragu i poruke, kao i da pregleda vaša pravila za poruke i osobe kojima pišete
  • da organizuje poštu: stanje pročitanosti, zastavice, neželjenu poštu, premeštanje, arhiviranje, nove fascikle i brisanje u fasciklu , kao i da napušta liste za slanje kada vi to odobrite
    • -
  • da piše radne verzije koje ćete vi poslati
    • +
  • da piše radne verzije koje ćete vi poslati, kao i da menja ili uklanja radne verzije koje je napisao dok ih vi ne promenite
  • da šalje poštu, svaku poruku tek kada vi to odobrite

Zatim izaberite naloge koje sme da vidi i kliknite na . odbija program i za njega vas više nećemo pitati.

-

Agent nikada ništa ne briše trajno i nikada ne menja podešavanja vašeg naloga. Kada agent pročita poruku, ona se ne označava kao pročitana. Ono što agent promeni odmah se vidi u prozorima.

+

Agent nikada ništa ne briše trajno i nikada ne menja podešavanja vašeg naloga. Može da čita i isproba vaša pravila za poruke, ali nikada ne može da ih kreira, menja ili briše. Kada agent pročita poruku, ona se ne označava kao pročitana. Ono što agent promeni odmah se vidi u prozorima.

Napuštanje lista za slanje

Agent koji sme da organizuje poštu može da zatraži da otkaže vašu pretplatu na liste za slanje. Inbox Classic vas prvo jednom pita i navodi svaku listu po njenom pošiljaocu:

diff --git a/core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/agents-sending.html b/core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/agents-sending.html index 67a9c61e..f42392be 100644 --- a/core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/agents-sending.html +++ b/core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/agents-sending.html @@ -13,8 +13,11 @@ -

Agent pita za jednu po jednu poruku. Poruke i radne verzije koje napiše završavaju se vašim potpisom, kao i vaše.

+

Agent pita za jednu po jednu poruku. Ako vam treba vremena da odgovorite, agent dobija obaveštenje da poruka čeka na vas i kasnije može da pita šta ste odlučili. Poruke i radne verzije koje napiše završavaju se vašim potpisom, kao i vaše.

Poruka koju pošaljete čeka 30 sekundi u fascikli Izlazno sanduče. Dok ne ode, možete da je izbrišete tamo ili da kliknete na u meniju > .

+

Radne verzije koje piše agent

+

Kada otvorite radnu verziju koju je napisao agent, red iznad poruke navodi naziv agenta. Pre slanja proverite primaoce i tekst.

+

Agent može da menja ili ukloni svoju radnu verziju dok je vi sami ne sačuvate. Od tada je radna verzija vaša.

Agent koji ima i druge alatke, na primer pregledanje veba ili čitanje vaših datoteka, mogao bi preko njih da prenese ono što pročita. Inbox Classic to ne može da vidi. Dozvolite agentu da šalje samo ako vam je to potrebno.

Välj vad varje AI-agent får göra med din e-post, och se och ångra vad den har gjort.

Första gången ett programs agent ansluter frågar Inbox Classic dig och anger programmets namn. Välj vad den får göra:

    -
  • läsa e-post: mappar, meddelandelistan, sökning och meddelanden
    • +
  • läsa e-post: mappar, meddelandelistan, konversationer, sökning och meddelanden, och slå upp dina meddelanderegler och de personer du skriver till
  • ordna e-post: läst och oläst, flaggor, skräppost, flytta, arkivera, skapa mappar och ta bort till , och lämna e-postlistor efter att du har sagt ja
    • -
  • skriva utkast som du skickar
    • +
  • skriva utkast som du skickar, och ändra eller ta bort de utkast den har skrivit tills du ändrar dem
  • skicka e-post, varje meddelande först efter att du har sagt ja

Välj sedan vilka konton den får se och klicka på . avvisar programmet, och du får inte frågan om det igen.

-

En agent tar aldrig bort något permanent och ändrar aldrig dina kontoinställningar. Ett meddelande som agenten läser markeras inte som läst. Det den ändrar syns direkt i fönstren.

+

En agent tar aldrig bort något permanent och ändrar aldrig dina kontoinställningar. Den kan läsa och prova dina meddelanderegler, men aldrig skapa, ändra eller ta bort någon. Ett meddelande som agenten läser markeras inte som läst. Det den ändrar syns direkt i fönstren.

Lämna e-postlistor

En agent som får ordna e-post kan be om att avsluta dina prenumerationer på e-postlistor. Inbox Classic frågar dig först en gång och visar varje lista med dess avsändare:

En agent frågar om ett meddelande i taget. Meddelanden och utkast som den skriver slutar med din signatur, precis som dina egna.

+

En agent frågar om ett meddelande i taget. Om du dröjer med svaret får agenten veta att meddelandet väntar på dig, och den kan senare fråga vad du bestämde. Meddelanden och utkast som den skriver slutar med din signatur, precis som dina egna.

Ett meddelande som du skickar väntar 30 sekunder i Utkorgen. Tills det har gått iväg kan du ta bort det där, eller klicka på i > .

+

Utkast som en agent skriver

+

När du öppnar ett utkast som en agent har skrivit visas agentens namn på en rad ovanför meddelandet. Kontrollera mottagarna och texten innan du skickar det.

+

Agenten kan ändra eller ta bort sitt utkast tills du själv sparar det. Därefter är utkastet ditt.

En agent som också har andra verktyg, till exempel för att surfa på webben eller läsa dina filer, kan föra vidare det den läser genom dem. Inbox Classic kan inte se dem. Låt en agent skicka bara om du behöver det.

Bir programın aracısı ilk kez bağlandığında Inbox Classic programın adını vererek size sorar. Neler yapabileceğini seçin:

    -
  • postayı okuma: klasörler, ileti listesi, arama ve iletiler
    • +
  • postayı okuma: klasörler, ileti listesi, konuşmalar, arama ve iletiler, ayrıca ileti kurallarınıza ve yazıştığınız kişilere bakma
  • postayı düzenleme: okundu durumu, bayraklar, gereksiz posta, taşıma, arşivleme, yeni klasörler ve klasörüne silme, ayrıca siz onay verdikten sonra posta listelerinden ayrılma
    • -
  • sizin göndermeniz için taslak yazma
    • +
  • sizin göndermeniz için taslak yazma, ayrıca siz değiştirene kadar yazdığı taslakları değiştirme veya kaldırma
  • posta gönderme, her ileti için ancak siz onay verdikten sonra

Ardından görebileceği hesapları seçin ve düğmesine tıklayın. programı reddeder ve size bir daha sorulmaz.

-

Bir aracı hiçbir şeyi kalıcı olarak silmez ve hesap ayarlarınızı asla değiştirmez. Bir iletiyi okuması onu okundu olarak işaretlemez. Değiştirdikleri pencerelerde hemen görünür.

+

Bir aracı hiçbir şeyi kalıcı olarak silmez ve hesap ayarlarınızı asla değiştirmez. İleti kurallarınızı okuyup deneyebilir, ancak asla kural oluşturamaz, değiştiremez veya silemez. Bir iletiyi okuması onu okundu olarak işaretlemez. Değiştirdikleri pencerelerde hemen görünür.

Posta listelerinden ayrılma

Postayı düzenleyebilen bir aracı, posta listelerindeki aboneliklerinizi iptal etmek isteyebilir. Inbox Classic önce size bir kez sorar ve her listeyi göndereniyle birlikte gösterir:

diff --git a/core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/agents-sending.html b/core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/agents-sending.html index ac997f2b..a5567182 100644 --- a/core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/agents-sending.html +++ b/core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/agents-sending.html @@ -13,8 +13,11 @@ -

Bir aracı her seferinde tek bir ileti için sorar. Yazdığı iletiler ve taslaklar, sizinkiler gibi imzanızla biter.

+

Bir aracı her seferinde tek bir ileti için sorar. Yanıt vermeniz biraz sürerse aracıya iletinin sizi beklediği bildirilir ve aracı ne karar verdiğinizi daha sonra sorabilir. Yazdığı iletiler ve taslaklar, sizinkiler gibi imzanızla biter.

Gönderdiğiniz bir ileti Giden Kutusu'nda 30 saniye bekler. Gidene kadar onu orada silebilir veya > içinde düğmesine tıklayabilirsiniz.

+

Bir aracının yazdığı taslaklar

+

Bir aracının yazdığı bir taslağı açtığınızda, iletinin üstündeki bir satır aracının adını gösterir. Göndermeden önce alıcıları ve metni kontrol edin.

+

Aracı, siz taslağı kendiniz kaydedene kadar onu değiştirebilir veya kaldırabilir. Bundan sonra taslak sizindir.

Web'de gezinme veya dosyalarınızı okuma gibi başka araçları da olan bir aracı, okuduklarını bunlar üzerinden aktarabilir. Inbox Classic bunları göremez. Bir aracının göndermesine yalnızca gerçekten gerekiyorsa izin verin.

Вибирайте, що кожен ШІ-агент може робити з вашою поштою, і переглядайте та скасовуйте те, що він зробив.

Коли агент програми під’єднується вперше, Inbox Classic запитує вас, називаючи програму. Виберіть, що йому можна робити:

    -
  • читати пошту: папки, список повідомлень, пошук і повідомлення
    • +
  • читати пошту: папки, список повідомлень, розмови, пошук і повідомлення, а також переглядати ваші правила для повідомлень і людей, яким ви пишете
  • упорядковувати пошту: стан прочитання, прапорці, небажана пошта, переміщення, архівування, нові папки й видалення в папку , а також вихід зі списків розсилки після вашого «так»
    • -
  • писати чернетки, які надсилаєте ви
    • +
  • писати чернетки, які надсилаєте ви, а також змінювати чи видаляти написані ним чернетки, доки ви їх не зміните
  • надсилати пошту, кожне повідомлення лише після вашого «так»

Потім виберіть облікові записи, які він може бачити, і клацніть . відхиляє програму, і про неї вас більше не запитуватимуть.

-

Агент ніколи нічого не видаляє назавжди й ніколи не змінює параметрів облікових записів. Читання повідомлення не позначає його як прочитане. Усе, що він змінює, одразу видно у вікнах.

+

Агент ніколи нічого не видаляє назавжди й ніколи не змінює параметрів облікових записів. Він може читати й випробовувати ваші правила для повідомлень, але ніколи не створює, не змінює й не видаляє їх. Читання повідомлення не позначає його як прочитане. Усе, що він змінює, одразу видно у вікнах.

Вихід зі списків розсилки

Агент, якому можна упорядковувати пошту, може попросити скасувати вашу підписку на списки розсилки. Спершу Inbox Classic один раз запитує вас і називає кожен список за його відправником:

core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/agents-sendi.diff:
diff --git a/core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/agents-sending.html b/core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/agents-sending.html index 186deaf5..3388c504 100644 --- a/core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/agents-sending.html +++ b/core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/agents-sending.html @@ -14,8 +14,11 @@ -

Агент запитує про одне повідомлення за раз. Повідомлення й чернетки, які він пише, закінчуються вашим підписом, як і ваші власні.

+

Агент запитує про одне повідомлення за раз. Якщо ви не відповідаєте одразу, агенту повідомляють, що повідомлення чекає на вас, і згодом він може запитати, що ви вирішили. Повідомлення й чернетки, які він пише, закінчуються вашим підписом, як і ваші власні.

Надіслане вами повідомлення чекає 30 секунд у папці «Вихідні». Доки воно не пішло, його можна там видалити або клацнути у меню > .

+

Чернетки, які пише агент

+

Коли ви відкриваєте чернетку, яку написав агент, рядок над повідомленням називає агента. Перевірте одержувачів і текст, перш ніж надіслати її.

+

Агент може змінювати або видаляти свою чернетку, доки ви самі її не збережете. Відтоді чернетка ваша.

Агент, який має й інші інструменти, наприклад перегляд вебсторінок чи читання ваших файлів, може передати прочитане через них. Inbox Classic цього не бачить. Дозволяйте агенту надсилати лише тоді, коли це справді потрібно.

core/crates/pe-html/help/bg/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic рисува тези изображения сам, както и прикачените, така че нищо в тях не се изпълнява. Изображение, което не може да нарисува (например HEIC), се показва като празно място. Анимираните изображения показват първия си кадър. Шрифтовете, изпратени със съобщението, не се използват.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ca/links-script.added_line: Les imatges i els tipus de lletra d’un missatge no arriben mai als descodificadors del sistema.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ca/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic dibuixa aquestes imatges ell mateix, com les imatges adjuntes, de manera que res del seu contingut s’executa. Una imatge que no pot dibuixar (com HEIC) es mostra com un espai en blanc. Les imatges animades mostren el primer fotograma. Els tipus de lletra enviats amb un missatge no s’utilitzen.

core/crates/pe-html/help/cs/links-script.added_line: Obrázky a písma ve zprávě se nikdy nedostanou k dekodérům systému.

core/crates/pe-html/help/cs/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic tyto obrázky kreslí sám, stejně jako přiložené obrázky, takže se v nich nic nespouští. Obrázek, který nedokáže nakreslit (například HEIC), se zobrazí jako prázdné místo. Animované obrázky zobrazí první snímek. Písma odeslaná se zprávou se nepoužívají.

core/crates/pe-html/help/da/links-script.added_line: Billeder og skrifttyper i en meddelelse når aldrig systemets egne dekodere.

core/crates/pe-html/help/da/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic tegner disse billeder selv, som det gør med vedhæftede billeder, så intet i dem kører. Et billede, det ikke kan tegne (for eksempel HEIC), vises som tomt område. Animerede billeder viser deres første billede. Skrifttyper, der sendes med en meddelelse, bruges ikke.

core/crates/pe-html/help/de/links-script.added_line: Bilder und Schriftarten in einer Nachricht erreichen nie die eigenen Decoder des Systems.

core/crates/pe-html/help/de/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic zeichnet diese Bilder selbst, wie angehängte Bilder, sodass nichts darin ausgeführt wird. Ein Bild, das es nicht zeichnen kann (etwa HEIC), erscheint als leere Fläche. Animierte Bilder zeigen ihr erstes Einzelbild. Mit einer Nachricht gesendete Schriftarten werden nicht verwendet.

core/crates/pe-html/help/el/links-script.added_line: Οι εικόνες και οι γραμματοσειρές ενός μηνύματος δεν φτάνουν ποτέ στους αποκωδικοποιητές του συστήματος.

core/crates/pe-html/help/el/pictures-tra.added_line: Το Inbox Classic ζωγραφίζει αυτές τις εικόνες το ίδιο, όπως και τις συνημμένες, ώστε τίποτα σε αυτές να μην εκτελείται. Μια εικόνα που δεν μπορεί να ζωγραφίσει (όπως HEIC) εμφανίζεται ως κενός χώρος. Οι κινούμενες εικόνες δείχνουν το πρώτο τους καρέ. Οι γραμματοσειρές που αποστέλλονται με ένα μήνυμα δεν χρησιμοποιούνται.

core/crates/pe-html/help/en/links-script.added_line: Pictures and fonts in a message never reach the system’s own decoders.

core/crates/pe-html/help/en/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic draws these pictures itself, as it does attached pictures, so nothing in them runs. A picture it cannot draw (such as HEIC) shows as blank space. Animated pictures show their first frame. Fonts sent with a message are not used.

core/crates/pe-html/help/es/links-script.added_line: Las imágenes y las fuentes de un mensaje nunca llegan a los decodificadores del sistema.

core/crates/pe-html/help/es/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic dibuja estas imágenes por sí mismo, como las imágenes adjuntas, de modo que nada de lo que contienen se ejecuta. Una imagen que no puede dibujar (como HEIC) se muestra como un espacio en blanco. Las imágenes animadas muestran su primer fotograma. Las fuentes enviadas con un mensaje no se utilizan.

core/crates/pe-html/help/et/links-script.added_line: Kirja piltide ja fontideni ei jõua kunagi süsteemi enda dekooderid.

core/crates/pe-html/help/et/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic joonistab need pildid ise, nagu manustatud pildidki, nii et neis ei käivitu midagi. Pilt, mida ta joonistada ei suuda (näiteks HEIC), kuvatakse tühja alana. Animeeritud pildid näitavad oma esimest kaadrit. Kirjaga kaasa saadetud fonte ei kasutata.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fi/links-script.added_line: Viestin kuvat ja fontit eivät koskaan päädy järjestelmän omille dekoodereille.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fi/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic piirtää nämä kuvat itse, kuten liitetytkin kuvat, joten niissä ei suoriteta mitään. Kuva, jota se ei voi piirtää (esimerkiksi HEIC), näkyy tyhjänä tilana. Animoidut kuvat näyttävät ensimmäisen ruutunsa. Viestin mukana lähetettyjä fontteja ei käytetä.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fr/links-script.added_line: Les images et les polices d'un message n'atteignent jamais les décodeurs du système.

core/crates/pe-html/help/fr/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic dessine lui-même ces images, comme les images jointes, de sorte que rien de ce qu'elles contiennent ne s'exécute. Une image qu'il ne peut pas dessiner (comme HEIC) apparaît comme un espace vide. Les images animées montrent leur première image. Les polices envoyées avec un message ne sont pas utilisées.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hr/links-script.added_line: Slike i fontovi u poruci nikada ne dolaze do dekodera samog sustava.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hr/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic te slike crta sam, kao i priložene slike, pa se ništa u njima ne izvršava. Slika koju ne može nacrtati (primjerice HEIC) prikazuje se kao prazan prostor. Animirane slike prikazuju svoj prvi kadar. Fontovi poslani s porukom ne koriste se.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hu/links-script.added_line: Az üzenetben lévő képek és betűtípusok soha nem jutnak el a rendszer saját dekódereihez.

core/crates/pe-html/help/hu/pictures-tra.added_line: Az Inbox Classic ezeket a képeket maga rajzolja ki, ahogy a csatolt képeket is, így semmi sem fut le bennük. Az a kép, amelyet nem tud kirajzolni (például a HEIC), üres helyként jelenik meg. Az animált képek az első képkockájukat mutatják. Az üzenettel küldött betűtípusokat nem használja.

core/crates/pe-html/help/it/links-script.added_line: Le immagini e i caratteri di un messaggio non raggiungono mai i decodificatori del sistema.

core/crates/pe-html/help/it/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic disegna da sé queste immagini, come quelle allegate, quindi nulla al loro interno viene eseguito. Un’immagine che non può disegnare (come HEIC) appare come uno spazio vuoto. Le immagini animate mostrano il primo fotogramma. I caratteri inviati con un messaggio non vengono usati.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lt/links-script.added_line: Laiško paveikslėliai ir šriftai niekada nepasiekia paties sistemos dekoderių.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lt/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic pats nupiešia šiuos paveikslėlius, kaip ir pridėtus, todėl juose niekas nevykdoma. Paveikslėlis, kurio nepavyksta nupiešti (pavyzdžiui, HEIC), rodomas kaip tuščia vieta. Animuoti paveikslėliai rodo pirmąjį kadrą. Su laišku atsiųsti šriftai nenaudojami.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lv/links-script.added_line: Ziņojuma attēli un fonti nekad nesasniedz sistēmas dekoderus.

core/crates/pe-html/help/lv/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic šos attēlus zīmē pats, tāpat kā pievienotos, tāpēc tajos nekas netiek izpildīts. Attēls, ko tas nevar uzzīmēt (piemēram, HEIC), tiek rādīts kā tukša vieta. Animētie attēli rāda savu pirmo kadru. Kopā ar ziņojumu nosūtītie fonti netiek izmantoti.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nb/links-script.added_line: Bilder og skrifttyper i en melding når aldri systemets egne dekodere.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nb/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic tegner disse bildene selv, slik det gjør med vedlagte bilder, så ingenting i dem kjøres. Et bilde det ikke kan tegne (for eksempel HEIC), vises som tomt område. Animerte bilder viser sin første ramme. Skrifttyper som sendes med en melding, brukes ikke.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nl/links-script.added_line: Afbeeldingen en lettertypen in een bericht bereiken nooit de eigen decoders van het systeem.

core/crates/pe-html/help/nl/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic tekent deze afbeeldingen zelf, net als bijgevoegde afbeeldingen, zodat er niets in wordt uitgevoerd. Een afbeelding die het niet kan tekenen (zoals HEIC), verschijnt als lege ruimte. Geanimeerde afbeeldingen tonen hun eerste beeld. Lettertypen die met een bericht zijn meegestuurd, worden niet gebruikt.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pl/links-script.added_line: Obrazy i czcionki z wiadomości nigdy nie trafiają do dekoderów systemu.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pl/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic rysuje te obrazy samodzielnie, tak jak obrazy załączone, więc nic w nich nie jest uruchamiane. Obraz, którego nie potrafi narysować (na przykład HEIC), pojawia się jako puste miejsce. Obrazy animowane pokazują pierwszą klatkę. Czcionki wysłane z wiadomością nie są używane.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt-BR/links-scr.added_line: As imagens e as fontes de uma mensagem nunca chegam aos decodificadores do sistema.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt-BR/pictures-.added_line: O Inbox Classic desenha essas imagens por conta própria, como faz com as imagens anexadas, então nada nelas é executado. Uma imagem que ele não consegue desenhar (como HEIC) aparece como um espaço em branco. Imagens animadas mostram o primeiro quadro. As fontes enviadas com uma mensagem não são usadas.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt/links-script.added_line: As imagens e os tipos de letra de uma mensagem nunca chegam aos descodificadores do sistema.

core/crates/pe-html/help/pt/pictures-tra.added_line: O Inbox Classic desenha estas imagens por si, como faz com as imagens anexadas, pelo que nada nelas é executado. Uma imagem que não consegue desenhar (como HEIC) aparece como um espaço em branco. As imagens animadas mostram a primeira imagem. Os tipos de letra enviados com uma mensagem não são usados.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ro/links-script.added_line: Imaginile și fonturile dintr-un mesaj nu ajung niciodată la decodoarele sistemului.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ro/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic desenează singur aceste imagini, ca pe cele atașate, așa că nimic din ele nu se execută. O imagine pe care nu o poate desena (de exemplu HEIC) apare ca un spațiu gol. Imaginile animate arată primul cadru. Fonturile trimise cu un mesaj nu sunt folosite.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ru/links-script.added_line: Изображения и шрифты из сообщения никогда не попадают в собственные декодеры системы.

core/crates/pe-html/help/ru/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic рисует эти изображения сам, как и вложенные, поэтому ничто в них не выполняется. Изображение, которое он не может нарисовать (например, HEIC), показывается пустым местом. Анимированные изображения показывают первый кадр. Шрифты, отправленные с сообщением, не используются.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sk/links-script.added_line: Obrázky a písma v správe sa nikdy nedostanú k dekodérom systému.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sk/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic tieto obrázky kreslí sám, rovnako ako prílohy, takže sa v nich nič nespúšťa. Obrázok, ktorý nedokáže nakresliť (napríklad HEIC), sa zobrazí ako prázdne miesto. Animované obrázky zobrazia prvú snímku. Písma odoslané so správou sa nepoužívajú.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sl/links-script.added_line: Slike in pisave v sporočilu nikoli ne dosežejo sistemskih dekodirnikov.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sl/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic te slike nariše sam, tako kot priložene slike, zato se v njih nič ne izvaja. Slika, ki je ne zna narisati (na primer HEIC), se prikaže kot prazen prostor. Animirane slike prikažejo prvi okvir. Pisave, poslane s sporočilom, se ne uporabljajo.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/links-s.added_line: Slike i fontovi u poruci nikada ne stižu do dekodera samog sistema.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sr-Latn/picture.added_line: Inbox Classic te slike crta sam, kao i priložene slike, pa se ništa u njima ne izvršava. Slika koju ne može da nacrta (na primer HEIC) prikazuje se kao prazan prostor. Animirane slike prikazuju svoj prvi kadar. Fontovi poslati uz poruku ne koriste se.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sv/links-script.added_line: Bilder och teckensnitt i ett meddelande når aldrig systemets egna avkodare.

core/crates/pe-html/help/sv/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic ritar dessa bilder själv, som det gör med bifogade bilder, så inget i dem körs. En bild som det inte kan rita (till exempel HEIC) visas som tomt utrymme. Animerade bilder visar sin första bildruta. Teckensnitt som skickas med ett meddelande används inte.

core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/links-script.added_line: İletideki resimler ve yazı tipleri sistemin kendi kod çözücülerine hiçbir zaman ulaşmaz.

core/crates/pe-html/help/tr/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic bu resimleri, ekli resimlerde olduğu gibi kendisi çizer; bu nedenle içlerinde hiçbir şey çalışmaz. Çizemediği bir resim (HEIC gibi) boş alan olarak görünür. Hareketli resimler ilk karelerini gösterir. İletiyle gönderilen yazı tipleri kullanılmaz.

core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/links-script.added_line: Зображення й шрифти з повідомлення ніколи не потрапляють до власних декодерів системи.

core/crates/pe-html/help/uk/pictures-tra.added_line: Inbox Classic малює ці зображення сам, як і вкладені, тому ніщо в них не виконується. Зображення, яке він не може намалювати (наприклад, HEIC), показується порожнім місцем. Анімовані зображення показують перший кадр. Шрифти, надіслані з повідомленням, не використовуються.

issues.finding: Prefix matching needs at least two characters; a one-character term matches a whole word.

after: includes its UTC start date; months/years are fixed 30/365 days. Negation is not implemented for all date/age/size operators, so minus must not be promised for every search term. to:/cc:/bcc: all search the full recipient index.
With several accounts, Flagged follows All Inboxes, All Sent and All Drafts; it is not immediately after All Inboxes.
Newest-message order applies to date/received sorts; other columns use the first message. Watched conversations still require notifications enabled.

issues.finding: Reply uses Reply-To when present; Reply All includes sender and To/Cc but excludes own addresses. Multiple forwards use the first subject with Fw:. An expanded quote is editable and removable. Compare simplifications that change meaning.

The worker removes the old draft after safely queueing the message, before actual sending succeeds. Undo Send ends at the countdown deadline, even if delivery has not succeeded. Retry is an attempt, not a delivery guarantee.

Memory-only decrypted previews do not imply that separately opened/saved attachments stay off disk. Opened copies persist until later startup cleanup; no origin mark on Linux. A crash during any preview render can disable PDFs. File-type blocking is not a blanket guarantee against arbitrary executable content.

Contact-picture display relies on provider-confirmed From domain, not individual identity. English forged-message-never wording overstates that. Imports skip a card only when it has addresses and every address is already known; matching names is insufficient.

Printing UI differs across platforms; a universal preview-window promise is too specific. Batch saves choose unused names; single Save As follows its platform file dialog. Compare overly broad no-overwrite claims.

issues.finding: Locked means the private part cannot be opened. A locked, refused or unavailable system secret store returns no master key for reading, so reset/missing protection is not the sole cause. Check availability before directing recovery from the private-key backup. Hungarian catalog entry was reopened and corrected in this batch.

STARTTLS is required before authentication: refusal aborts connection, not the app. SMTP 538 reports an encryption requirement and does not establish password correctness. TLS port suggestions require provider support; a local network does not itself provide encryption.

Signature validity proves unchanged signed content, not individual identity. Green/blue signer claims require a valid sender signature; verification applies to all listed addresses. Part counts describe protection states. Decrypted previews stay in memory, separately opened/saved files do not; searchable text can be stored unencrypted locally.

Learning a key does not verify its owner or automatically replace the chosen key. Address lookup first asks the domain and optionally keys.openpgp.org; handle lookup sends an identifier instead. Keep these qualifications where omitted or mistranslated.

This comparison queue adds no scope or review credit before affected passages are identified. English/app code remain outside this review.

issues.finding: The English help says attachments are saved and never opened from Inbox Classic. Opening is user-requested and uses the system-associated external app; recognized program/script/active formats are blocked. Corrected the Hungarian description, without editing English or code.

The reader strips message scripts/active markup, but app-owned scripts can execute; web links and mailto links are distinct. Embedded images are re-encoded by the previewer; their encodes still reach a web view, and allowed remote images are not routed through that same decoder. Replaced blanket no-code/no-system-decoder claims with the precise user-visible behavior.

Remote images are blocked by default. Trusted-sender rules use a provider-confirmed sender domain, not personal identity; encrypted parts require an explicit click even with trust/always settings. Logo sources can require a network request, so the help avoids an absolute no-tracking claim.

The highlighted sign-in code requires a provider-confirmed DKIM signature of the code domain or its parent. This does not verify the sender person. Compose status shows the link under the mouse, otherwise the text cursor.

A left-behind preview marker means the app ended while drawing a file, not necessarily a PDF and not proof the file itself caused termination. PDF previews are disabled on next startup. Hungarian now describes the observed condition.
