issues.finding: Read access includes conversations, message attachments, rules and people lookup. People lookup includes address-book entries and, with every account granted, mail contacts; it is not restricted to saved contacts. Organize uses the same Hungarian Ignore Conversation term as the actual command.

The create/rename log is written after enqueueing a server command, before success is known. Creation can finish its 15-second wait with the folder still absent. Hungarian says the action was requested. Previously completed agent-log-folder was reopened with no duplicate scope credit.

Attachment reads hand content to the agent, not to an external file-opening application. The list count is rows.len(), so grouped conversations can count rows instead of individual messages. A list-name placeable can be a folder or an unlocalized combined-scope identifier. Hungarian uses entries and an uninflected list label.

Unnamed agents are grouped by the recognized terminal program path, not globally across all terminals. --name gives a distinct stored grant, not a verified security identity. Only local programs under the same OS user connect through the supported IPC.

Read summaries combine independent positive counts per program/hour; details can have zero results. Log entries hold subjects, file names, queries and scope labels, not message bodies. Expiry happens on inserts; ordinary nonprotected changes may be pruned before 30 days. Clearing removes read records, hides changes and does not reset sending limits.

Encrypted mail exposes only the outer envelope, not decrypted body or attachments. Saving a draft in the editor, including autosave, ends agent ownership; deletion of other mail requires a destination. Agent-log send undo calls outbox_delete while the queued message remains, unlike the ordinary Undo Send countdown. Server changes are not all visible immediately.

context_audit_queue.instruction: English and app code unchanged. Compare affected current passages elsewhere; retain accurate wording and reopen only affected content. Comparison tasks add no review credit.

issues.finding: STARTTLS failure ends the connection attempt before authentication. A local network alone is not encryption; provider ports are conditional. Platform certificate trust is the default; explicit CLI certificate pinning exists, but no accept-anything mode or interactive certificate exception control was found.

System secret storage is the default, with an explicit memory-only mode and possible persistence failures. OAuth stores a refresh token even though it does not store the account password. Do not imply browser sign-in has no stored credentials.

Removing an account cascades to outbox rows and removes the stored account credential. Mark All Read applies to messages in every folder. Reordering and properties controls were checked on all three platforms. The preexisting Hungarian paragraph uses one all-inboxes control where English repeats it; retained its markup and used a clear reference back to the same view.

Check validates issuer discovery and endpoint configuration, not client credentials or mail access. Disabling an app affects offering it for new accounts; in-use apps cannot be removed. Google starts disabled for new accounts in this source. Avoid asserting the live verification status of the registered Google client.

TLS failures are broader than certificate identity failures. Raw low-level TLS diagnostics remain English, so the help quotes the actual text and explains it in Hungarian. The secure reader failure uses the current Hungarian catalog sentence.

Raw connection and timeout diagnostics remain English; localized failure wrappers are distinct. Port and TLS mode must match the provider. A queued message survives a failed connection and is retried, but reachability alone does not guarantee successful delivery.

Two-step verification does not universally require or enable app passwords. Gmail app passwords require both two-step verification and account support. Outlook.com/Microsoft 365 guidance uses browser sign-in. iCloud is a supported app-password example. Quotes match current reader failure and sign-in-refused catalogs.

issues.finding: All platforms suppress new-mail notifications when disabled or when the main window is in front, including watched conversations. Core notifications exclude ignored or rule-suppressed mail. Ten-minute sync is supplemented by Inbox watching, not a guarantee of instant arrival. Windows/macOS badge counts refer to Inboxes. Linux dock badges depend on desktop support; closing exits when there is no tray host.

Ahead::Never disables prefetch and neighbor fetches. Recent uses 30 days and 1 MiB for bulk prefetch; neighbor fetches use the size limit but not the date cutoff, and select date-adjacent messages within the folder rather than arbitrary visible rows. Bulk prefetch excludes Junk, Trash and All. Cache eviction removes bodies, not whole messages or the entire database, and spares Drafts and messages opened in this run. The byte cap can therefore be exceeded. Large-message text-first rendering above 1 MiB is conditional on a usable structure and sufficiently small initial parts.

Quoted headings now match the actual Hungarian catalog. Missing local content is fetched on opening; arrival time is not guaranteed. An open failed message is retried after account sync; explicit retry remains platform-specific. A parser failure establishes that Inbox Classic could not read the message, not that no other mail program can. WebView2 Runtime may need installation and is distinct from the installed Edge browser.

The card is a local analysis of a recognized delivery report. Its links to original mail depend on finding that message in the account. A delayed report does not establish final failure or guarantee later delivery. Resend guidance is limited to final failures; avoid a guaranteed greylisting delivery time. Local analysis does not imply the entire app or rendered message performs no network access.

issues.finding: Paths describe defaults: --store and Linux data-directory settings can override them. The mail database itself is not encrypted. Account passwords, OAuth refresh tokens and application client secrets use the system secret store by default; unavailable or memory-only storage must not be described as guaranteed persistence. Linux uses a Secret Service provider, not exclusively GNOME Keyring. Private OpenPGP keys are encrypted in the database with a separate protection key. DNS over HTTPS applies to configuration MX/SRV lookups; ordinary server hostname resolution uses the system resolver. Provider autoconfig requests can include an email address. Logos use persistent cached SVG data, not a fresh download on every app run: source retention is 30 days, failed requests wait 24 hours. External pictures can be enabled by settings/trusted-sender rules; encrypted parts still require a click. Direct unsubscribe requires confirmation and trusted DKIM coverage of the unsubscribe headers. Key discovery includes manual lookup and fingerprint/key-ID requests; publishing sends public key data and confirmation addresses. OTP detection uses a trusted provider verdict for the relevant origin/From domain or a parent, not any DKIM signature. Mac automatic update checking is optional.

The passphrase must match and contain at least eight Unicode characters. Only protected exports can contain saved account/app secrets and own private keys. Private keys that cannot be opened locally are skipped. Setup exports contain no messages, so only server-held mail can download on the other machine; local outgoing mail is not transferred. An unprotected export requires fresh sign-in, potentially through the browser. Existing accounts are kept, selected contained settings applied, contacts merged, pending rule folders resolved after sync and replacement contact keys left for user selection.

The Windows uninstaller's remove-mail confirmation deletes the full local data directory, including settings, contacts, keys and queued mail; WebView cache is removed separately. The Windows uninstaller explicitly leaves system credential-store entries, and uninstalling must not be represented as clearing all secrets. Preserve literal package commands without executing them.

Mac Sparkle checks are enabled by default but controlled by settings; the help must not promise unconditional automatic updating or a prompt before every possible installation. Windows opens system association settings for installed copies when the association is not already set. Mac/Linux attempt system association changes and report failure; success is not unconditional. Mailto and .eml associations are separate. Mailto parsing accepts addresses, subject and body, not attachments or arbitrary fields. All three frontends require an existing account and ask the user to click the link again after adding one.

verified_context: Background decryption uses available private keys and already cached message sources, with the encrypted-search setting enabled. A failed attempt waits for an explicit open or a later setting reset; do not promise every downloaded message decrypts.

Disabling encrypted search logically removes decrypted text, snippets, attachment metadata and protected-subject replacements from the index/list; it restores the outer subject. This is not a secure-erasure claim. The setting defaults on.
Agent message/attachment access refuses encrypted content; the agent envelope can still contain outer sender/recipient/date/subject fields. Do not say agents have no metadata access.

Address lookup tries the address domain WKD first, then keys.openpgp.org when enabled. Explicit key-handle lookup sends a fingerprint/key ID instead of an email address. The keyserver switch does not disable domain lookup. UI/help source says only an address is sent; account for the separate identifier-lookup route during review.

List encrypted/signed marks classify message protection, not signature validity or verified ownership. ListEncrypted is the preview/status placeholder when there is no decrypted snippet. Protected-subject and preview storage depends on the indexing setting.

New-mail notification code always substitutes ListEncrypted for encrypted messages, independently of subsequent decryption. The list placeholder is conditional on a missing decrypted snippet. Translate these as distinct conditions.

verified_context: Compose status describes intended sending protection, not proof of delivery. Encrypt forces signing when sending; encrypted drafts are encrypted only to the sender and are not signed. Drafts retaining an encrypted quote or extracted attachment stay encrypted even if the toggle was switched off.
Signatures allow checking content integrity and signing-key use. They do not by themselves prove the displayed sender identity or who wrote the message; ownership verification is separate.

Recipient warning/missing counts include expired, revoked or otherwise unusable keys. Any key is insufficient. Own sender key must also be usable. Placeholders can contain typed names or addresses; no inflection attached to them.

Individual recipient chips use a green lock for verified keys and a blue lock for found/unverified or own keys. Lookup is a gray lock on Windows, an hourglass on Mac and a spinner on Linux. Missing/unusable keys use warning icons. The separate overall status bar adds a shield when all other recipients are verified. Do not confuse that shield with the individual recipient chip; a color/status table works across platforms.

The explicit Find Key action retries even after a negative lookup, subject to a one-minute limit; automatic lookup skips recent failed requests. Existing WKD/keyserver privacy and consent notes remain applicable.

Turning encryption off for a reply/forward asks first. Sending unencrypted remains blocked while encrypted quoted text, inline media or extracted attachments remain. Send Without Encryption may be disabled; it is not an unconditional alternative.
Remove from Message removes the selected recipient from To, Cc and Bcc, without deleting a contact. Attach My Public Key exports the public key of the selected From address, not a private key.

Core protection wraps the content under top-level headers; do not claim all metadata is hidden. Sent copies retain encryption. Signing/encryption happens before queuing; a compose status is not a successful-send receipt.

verified_context: agents.rs::ask_lists allows one pending unsubscribe question per host, excludes special-use Junk, deduplicates URLs and accepts only available verified-sender one-click unsubscribe endpoints.
The limit is30 approved list requests per host in a rolling86400-second window. Counted when user says yes, including later failures; refusals do not consume quota.

Consent sends one-click HTTP requests in the background; it does not send an ordinary message, move/delete existing mail or guarantee the list will stop sending. Refused-log $senders is comma-separated sender addresses only. Failure $subject is a message subject, $reason is runtime failure text.

All three platforms select refusal by default; Windows has two distinct mnemonic buttons. macOS/Linux use plain shared labels. Lists show sender address first, name, subject and endpoint host; scroll after roughly eight rows.

agent_ask_send allows one outstanding message question per program. agent_outgoing appends account text signature when include_signature is true, the default; agents can set it false. This is not a cryptographic signature.
Earlier Undo correction remains: an absent Outbox row is not proof of delivery, since manual deletion also removes it. Sending paragraph preceding the new insertion is preserved exactly.
source_issues: New help incorrectly promises every agent message/draft includes a signature: include_signature defaults true but is optional. Say by default and distinguish text signature.
New help says30 lists a day; actual quota is per program over preceding24 hours and counts approvals, including failed requests.

hu.before: A leveleket mások írják, és egy üzenet megpróbálhatja rávenni az ügynököt, hogy továbbítsa vagy törölje a leveleit. Az Inbox Classic elrejti az ügynökök elől azt a szöveget, amelyet az üzenet Ön elől rejt el, és közli velük, hogy a levelek nem utasítások. Egy ügynököt ennek ellenére is be lehet csapni. Csak azt engedélyezze, amire szüksége van.
hu.after: Egy üzenet tartalma megpróbálhatja rávenni az ügynököt a levelek továbbítására vagy törlésére. Az Inbox Classic kihagyja az ügynöknek átadott szövegből a rejtett tartalmat, és arra utasítja, hogy a levelek tartalmát adatként kezelje, ne követendő utasításként. Az ügynököt ennek ellenére is be lehet csapni. Csak a szükséges jogosultságokat adja meg.
hu.scope: Within an already-pending complete help draft; no extra scope or reopened completed passage.

lt.before: Laiškus rašo kiti žmonės, ir laiškas gali bandyti įkalbėti agentą persiųsti ar panaikinti jūsų laiškus. Inbox Classic slepia nuo agentų tekstą, kurį laiškas slepia nuo jūsų, ir praneša jiems, kad laiškai nėra nurodymai. Agentą vis tiek galima apgauti. Leiskite tik tai, ko jums reikia.
lt.after: Laiško turinys gali bandyti paskatinti agentą persiųsti ar panaikinti jūsų laiškus. Inbox Classic iš agentui perduodamo teksto pašalina paslėptą turinį ir nurodo laiškų turinį laikyti duomenimis, o ne nurodymais, kuriuos reikia vykdyti. Agentą vis tiek galima apgauti. Suteikite tik būtinas prieigos teises.
lt.scope: Within an already-pending complete help draft; no extra scope or reopened completed passage.

lv.before: Pastu raksta citi cilvēki, un ziņojums var mēģināt pierunāt aģentu pārsūtīt vai izdzēst jūsu pastu. Inbox Classic slēpj no aģentiem tekstu, ko ziņojums slēpj no jums, un saka tiem, ka pasts nav norādījumi. Aģentu tomēr var apmānīt. Atļaujiet tikai to, kas jums vajadzīgs.
lv.after: Ziņojuma tekstā var būt mēģinājumi panākt, lai aģents pārsūta vai izdzēš jūsu pastu. Inbox Classic izlaiž slēpto saturu tekstā, ko nodod aģentam, un norāda, ka ziņojumu saturs jāuztver kā dati, nevis izpildāmi norādījumi. Tomēr aģentu var apmānīt. Piešķiriet tikai nepieciešamās piekļuves tiesības.
lv.scope: Within an already-pending complete help draft; no extra scope or reopened completed passage.

pl.before: Pocztę piszą inni ludzie, a wiadomość może próbować namówić agenta do przesłania dalej lub usunięcia Twojej poczty. Inbox Classic ukrywa przed agentami tekst, który wiadomość ukrywa przed Tobą, i mówi im, że poczta nie jest poleceniami. Agenta wciąż można oszukać. Zezwalaj tylko na to, czego potrzebujesz.
pl.after: Treść wiadomości może próbować nakłonić agenta do przesłania dalej lub usunięcia Twojej poczty. Inbox Classic pomija ukrytą treść w tekście przekazywanym agentowi i nakazuje traktować wiadomości jako dane, a nie polecenia do wykonania. Agenta nadal można oszukać. Przyznawaj tylko potrzebne uprawnienia.
pl.scope: Within an already-pending complete help draft; no extra scope or reopened completed passage.

ro.before: E-mailurile sunt scrise de alte persoane, iar un mesaj poate încerca să convingă un agent să vă redirecționeze sau să vă șteargă e-mailurile. Inbox Classic ascunde de agenți textul pe care un mesaj îl ascunde de dvs. și le spune că e-mailurile nu sunt instrucțiuni. Un agent poate fi totuși păcălit. Permiteți doar ce vă trebuie.
ro.after: Mesajele altor persoane pot conține instrucțiuni menite să păcălească un agent, de exemplu să vă redirecționeze sau să vă șteargă mesajele. Inbox Classic ascunde de agenți textul care nu vă este afișat și le cere să trateze mesajele ca date, nu ca instrucțiuni de urmat. Un agent poate fi totuși păcălit. Acordați numai permisiunile necesare.
ro.scope: Within an already-pending complete help draft; no extra scope or reopened completed passage.

ru.before: Почту пишут другие люди, и сообщение может попытаться уговорить агента переслать или удалить вашу почту. Inbox Classic скрывает от агентов текст, который сообщение скрывает от вас, и сообщает им, что почта не является инструкциями. Агента все равно можно обмануть. Разрешайте только то, что вам нужно.
ru.after: Чужие сообщения могут содержать инструкции, рассчитанные на обман агента, например просьбу переслать или удалить вашу почту. Inbox Classic скрывает от агентов невидимый вам текст и указывает им воспринимать сообщения как данные, а не как инструкции к действию. Однако агента все равно можно обмануть. Разрешайте только необходимые действия.
ru.scope: Within an already-pending complete help draft; no extra scope or reopened completed passage.

sk.before: Poštu píšu iní ľudia a správa sa môže pokúsiť prehovoriť agenta, aby vašu poštu preposlal alebo odstránil. Inbox Classic pred agentmi skryje text, ktorý správa skrýva pred vami, a oznámi im, že pošta nie sú pokyny. Agenta sa aj tak dá oklamať. Povoľte iba to, čo potrebujete.
sk.after: Cudzie správy môžu obsahovať pokyny určené na oklamanie agenta, napríklad žiadosť o preposlanie alebo odstránenie vašej pošty. Inbox Classic pred agentmi skrýva text, ktorý vám správa nezobrazuje, a upozorňuje ich, aby obsah pošty nepovažovali za pokyny na vykonanie. Agenta však možno aj tak oklamať. Povoľte iba potrebné činnosti.
sk.scope: Already-pending full topic; no additional scope.

sl.before: Pošto pišejo drugi ljudje in sporočilo lahko poskuša agenta pregovoriti, da posreduje ali izbriše vašo pošto. Inbox Classic pred agenti skrije besedilo, ki ga sporočilo skriva pred vami, in jim pove, da pošta ni navodilo. Agenta je še vedno mogoče preslepiti. Dovolite samo tisto, kar potrebujete.
sl.after: Tuja sporočila lahko vsebujejo navodila, namenjena zavajanju agenta, na primer zahtevo za posredovanje ali brisanje vaše pošte. Inbox Classic pred agenti skrije besedilo, ki vam ga sporočilo ne prikaže, in jih opozori, naj vsebine pošte ne obravnavajo kot navodil za dejanja. Agenta je kljub temu mogoče preslepiti. Dovolite le potrebna dejanja.
sl.scope: Already-pending full topic; no additional scope.

sv.before: E-post skrivs av andra, och ett meddelande kan försöka övertala en agent att vidarebefordra eller ta bort din e-post. Inbox Classic döljer för agenter den text som ett meddelande döljer för dig, och talar om för dem att e-post inte är instruktioner. En agent kan ändå luras. Tillåt bara det du behöver.
sv.after: Meddelanden från andra kan innehålla instruktioner som försöker få agenten att vidarebefordra eller ta bort din e-post. Inbox Classic döljer text som inte visas för dig och uppmanar agenten att inte följa instruktioner i e-posten. Agenten kan ändå bli lurad. Tillåt bara de åtgärder du behöver.
sv.scope: Already-pending full topic; no additional scope.

uk.before: Пошту пишуть інші люди, і повідомлення може спробувати вмовити агента переслати чи видалити вашу пошту. Inbox Classic приховує від агентів текст, який повідомлення приховує від вас, і повідомляє їм, що пошта не є інструкціями. Проте агента все одно можна обдурити. Дозволяйте лише те, що вам потрібно.
uk.after: Повідомлення від інших людей можуть містити інструкції, покликані змусити агента переслати чи видалити вашу пошту. Inbox Classic приховує текст, якого ви не бачите, і вказує агенту не виконувати інструкції з повідомлень. Проте агента все одно можна обдурити. Дозволяйте лише потрібні вам дії.
uk.scope: Already-pending full topic; no additional scope.

edits.after:
Напускане на пощенски списъци

Агент, който може да подрежда поща, може да поиска да ви отпише от пощенски списъци. Inbox Classic първо ви пита веднъж, като показва всеки списък по неговия подател:

  • моли всеки списък да спре да ви изпраща съобщения.
  • , бутонът по подразбиране, ги оставя такива, каквито са.

Агентът не може да ви отписва от съобщения в , нито от повече от 30 списъка на ден.

Αποχώρηση από λίστες αλληλογραφίας

Ένας πράκτορας που μπορεί να οργανώνει την αλληλογραφία μπορεί να ζητήσει να καταργήσει την εγγραφή σας από λίστες αλληλογραφίας. Το Inbox Classic σάς ρωτά πρώτα μία φορά, δείχνοντας κάθε λίστα με τον αποστολέα της:

  • Το κουμπί ζητά από κάθε λίστα να σταματήσει να σας στέλνει μηνύματα.
  • Το κουμπί , η προεπιλογή, τις αφήνει όπως είναι.

Ένας πράκτορας δεν μπορεί να καταργήσει την εγγραφή σας μέσω μηνυμάτων στον φάκελο , ούτε από περισσότερες από 30 λίστες την ημέρα.

edits.after:
Изображения и PDF файлове в съобщението

Изображенията и първите страници на PDF файловете се показват след текста на съобщението, с имената и размерите си. Щракнете върху някое, за да отворите файла. По-дългият PDF файл има връзка, която го отваря.

Това са копия, които Inbox Classic създава сам: нищо във файла не се изпълнява и нищо не се зарежда от интернет. Файл, който не може да бъде показан, и файловете на подписани или шифровани съобщения са само в списъка с файлове.

За да виждате само списъка, изключете в . Ако PDF файл някога затвори Inbox Classic, PDF файловете вече не се показват и съобщението казва това; включете , за да ги показвате отново.

Отваряне на прикачен файл

glossary_update.after:
## Agent unsubscribe log timing

The `agent-log-unsubscribed` entry is written when the user approves the request, before any HTTP request
is made. Translate it as user approval, not completed cancellation or a request already sent. The subject
placeholder identifies the source message, not a list name; introduce it with the localized message label.
Use the language's normal form of address. Polish uses an impersonal approval to avoid gendered user forms;
Slovenian addresses the approving user here, rather than using the masculine participle for an agent action.

## Fixed terms
